title: Blinded
subtitle: You cannot see
description: A blinded creature can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight.

bullets.content: A blinded creature suffers from the following effects:

items: Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.
The creature's attack rolls have disadvantage.

bullets.content: These effects apply to any creature that relies on sight.

title: Charmed
subtitle: You are charmed by another
description: A charmed creature can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with harmful abilities or magical effects.

bullets.content: In addition, the charmer has advantage on any ability check to interact socially with the creature.

title: Deafened
subtitle: You cannot hear
description: A deafened creature can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.

bullets.content: This condition can be caused by magical effects like the Silence spell or by loud noises like a thunderclap.

title: Dying
subtitle: You are at 0 HP and dying
description: If you drop to 0 hit points and aren't killed outright, you fall unconscious and are in the process of dying.

bullets.content: At the start of each of your turns while dying, you make a death saving throw. The rules are:

items: Roll a d20. On a 10 or higher, you succeed. Otherwise, you fail.
On your third success, you become stable.
On your third failure, you die.
Rolling a 1 counts as two failures. Rolling a 20 makes you regain 1 hit point.
Taking any damage while at 0 hit points counts as one death saving throw failure.

bullets.content: Healing of any amount will bring you back to consciousness and end the dying state.

title: Exhaustion
subtitle: You are drained
description: Exhaustion is measured in six levels. An effect can give a creature one or more levels of exhaustion.

bullets.content: The levels of exhaustion have the following cumulative effects:

rows: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws

bullets.content: Finishing a long rest reduces a creature's exhaustion level by 1, provided it has also had some food and drink.

title: Frightened
subtitle: You are afraid
description: A frightened creature suffers from the following effects:

items: It has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its fear is within line of sight.
It can't willingly move closer to the source of its fear.

bullets.content: This condition ends when the source of fear is removed or the effect's duration expires.

title: Grappled
subtitle: You are held
description: A grappled creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.

bullets.content: The condition also ends if the grappler is incapacitated or if an effect removes the grappled creature from the grappler's reach.

title: Incapacitated
subtitle: You can't take actions or reactions
description: An incapacitated creature can't take actions or reactions.

bullets.content: Many other conditions, such as Paralyzed or Stunned, also apply the Incapacitated condition.

title: Invisible
subtitle: You cannot be seen
description: An invisible creature is impossible to see without the aid of magic or a special sense. For the purpose of hiding, the creature is heavily obscured.

bullets.content: An invisible creature gains the following effects:

items: Attack rolls against the creature have disadvantage.
The creature's attack rolls have advantage.

bullets.content: The creature's location can still be detected by any noise it makes or tracks it leaves.

title: Paralyzed
subtitle: You are immobilized
description: A paralyzed creature is incapacitated and can't move or speak.

bullets.content: The creature also suffers from the following effects:

items: It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.
Any attack that hits it is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.

bullets.content: This is a severe condition that renders a creature completely helpless.

title: Petrified
subtitle: You are turned to stone
description: A petrified creature is transformed, along with any nonmagical object it is wearing or carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone).

bullets.content: The creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. In addition:

items: Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.
It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
It has resistance to all damage.
It is immune to poison and disease.

bullets.content: The creature's weight is increased by a factor of ten, and it ceases aging.

title: Poisoned
subtitle: You are poisoned
description: A poisoned creature has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

bullets.content: Many monster attacks and poisonous substances can inflict this condition.

title: Prone
subtitle: You are lying down
description: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, unless it stands up.

bullets.content: The creature is also affected in the following ways:

items: It has disadvantage on attack rolls.
An attack roll against it has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet. Otherwise, the attack roll has disadvantage.

bullets.content: Standing up costs an amount of movement equal to half its speed.

title: Restrained
subtitle: You are restrained
description: A restrained creature's speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.

bullets.content: The creature also suffers from the following effects:

items: Attack rolls against the creature have advantage, and its attack rolls have disadvantage.
The creature has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

bullets.content: This condition can be caused by spells like Entangle or being held in a giant spider's web.

title: Stunned
subtitle: You are stunned
description: A stunned creature is incapacitated, can't move, and can speak only falteringly.

bullets.content: The creature also suffers from the following effects:

items: It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against the creature have advantage.

bullets.content: This condition often results from a powerful blow or a stunning magical effect.

title: Unconscious
subtitle: You are senseless
description: An unconscious creature is incapacitated, can't move or speak, and is unaware of its surroundings. The creature drops whatever it's holding and falls prone.

bullets.content: In addition, the creature suffers from the following effects:

items: It automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
Attack rolls against it have advantage.
Any attack that hits it is a critical hit if the attacker is within 5 feet.

bullets.content: This condition occurs when a creature drops to 0 hit points, is affected by certain spells, or is rendered unconscious by other means.
